title.en: Racial Ability Tuning Pass for WoW: Forever
title.es: Pase de ajuste de habilidad racial para WoW: Forever

summary.en: Racial Ability Tuning Pass for WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Racial Ability Tuning Pass para WoW: Para siempre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced upcoming racial ability tuning for the launch of WoW: Forever!
Blizzard
View Original
As we approach the launch of WoW Forever, we’ve been reflecting on feedback we’ve heard on racial abilities and passive traits: Some players have expressed that some of the new racial traits feel too generic, while others have expressed concerns that some are objectively stronger than others.

In taking a final pass on these, we’ve prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles. In some places where we had replaced role- or class-focused racials with generic ones, we’re rolling those changes back. One exception to this is the weapon specialization racials, like humans’ Sword Specialization or orcs’ Axe Specialization. While those have a strong fantasy component to them, it is not healthy in the long run for future raid and dungeon loot tables to be evaluated through the lens of “required” weapon types.

At the same time, we’re doing a tuning pass on some of the remaining passive bonuses to help ensure that they aren’t skewing outcomes in a way that limits player preferences.

Racial Abilities and Traits

  • Human
    • Ruthless now increases critical chance by 1% (was 2%).
    • Human Spirit now increases Spirit by 10% (was 5%).
  • Dwarf
    • Earth Fury (2% increased critical strike damage and healing) removed.
    • Added: Artisan’s Precision - Increases hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.
  • Tauren
    • Plainsrunning now grants 2% movement speed per stack (was 1%), for a total max increase of 60% (was 30%).
    • Plainsrunning no longer increases mounted movement speed.
    • Endurance no longer provides any modifiers beyond 5% increased Health (no hit chance or critical damage modifiers).
  • Orc
    • Savage removed (1% increased critical strike chance).
    • Command re-added, increasing Warlock and Hunter pet damage by 5%.
  • Skyborne
    • Wind-Blessed Haste bonus reduced to 2% (was 3%).
    • Read Leyline now increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50% (was 100%), with a 15-second duration. This ability cannot be used while Innervate is active, and will be replaced by Innervate as a more powerful effect.
    • Using Read Leyline at a Ley Line now also grants “Attuned” for 1 hour. While Attuned, the benefit of Read Leyline is increased to 100% regeneration increase. Attuned persists through death.
    • Skysight is now a 15% increased movement speed (was 10%), with a 15-second duration.
    • Using Skysight at an elemental convergence now also grants “Charged” for 1 hour. While Charged, the benefit of Skysight is a 30% movement speed increase. Charged persists through death.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced a WoW: Forever Poster Signing on November 2nd where players can meet the devs and tickets are available tomorrow!

This article originally mentioned that tickets were available today, but they are actually available tomorrow. We apologize for the mistake and confusion.


Tickets are available starting tomorrow, and there are only a limited number of tickets. Players can meet developers behind WoW: Forever and celebrate the upcoming release!

WoW: Forever Poster Signing Tickets
Blizzard
View Original
Join us for the WoW: Forever Poster Signing on November 2, 2026, at the Irvine Improv. 

Get Free Tickets

Attendance is limited, so make sure to obtain your free ticket from TIXR beginning Tuesday, October 27 at 12:00 pm PDT for your chance to attend this special event.

Meet the Developers

Meet developers behind the game, connect with fellow adventures, and celebrate the upcoming release of WoW: Forever on November 4, 2026. 

Get There On Time

Guests are strongly encouraged to arrive early at their designated arrival window. Entry will be granted to all guests that registered in advance with a valid QR code for their time slot. The QR code must be scanned at the check-in tent located outside the venue. Due to the limited time and space within the venue, we will be unable to accommodate anyone without a ticket. Irvine Improv is also ADA compliant.  

Visit our event page for more information.

We anticipate a fun and busy celebration and can’t wait to see you there!

title.es: ¡Prueba Talebound en el PTR del parche 12.1.7 este viernes!

summary.en: Test Talebound on the Patch 12.1.7 PTR This Friday!...
summary.es: ¡Prueba Talebound en el PTR del parche 12.1.7 este viernes!...

contentHtml:
Blizzard is hosting a test of Talebound this Friday on the Patch 12.1.7 PTR! No subscription is needed.

Talebound is WoW's newest standalone game mode coming in Patch 12.1.7 and features Roguelite gameplay. Players will head into the world of Talebound, where they'll take part in the tales of the Mysterious Storyteller as one of three new classes.

Talebound Guide
Blizzard
View Original
Take the Talebound demo for a spooky spin on the Player Test Realm (PTR) and experience the Red Hollow introduction, three eerie tales across Normal, Veteran, and Heroic difficulties, and all three classes: Slayer, Inquisitor, and Witch. No subscription is required to take part.
When : 30 October–1 November

What’s in the Demo

  • Introduction : Red Hollow
  • Three Tales : Darkhaven, Greenthistle Wood, and Greywake's Expedition
  • Three Classes : Slayer, Inquisitor, and Witch
  • Three Difficulty Levels : Normal, Veteran, and Heroic

Welcome to Red Hollow

Prepare to be drawn into the macabre world of Talebound, where you become part of the dark chronicles of a mysterious Storyteller, chillingly brought to life.

You’re a lone traveler, journeying down a darkened road where you’ll encounter a mysterious storyteller who pulls you into a world of his own creation. This is the very beginning of your adventure in Quillgrave.

Venture solo or with friends through eerie tales, where danger is written on every page.

Three Dreadful Tales to Demo

Three of Talebound’s chilling tales will be available during the demo, each with three challenging difficulty levels: Normal, Veteran, and Heroic. Battle fearsome enemies and bosses, solve perplexing puzzles, and discover treasure and relics as you delve deeper into the Storyteller’s twisted creations
Darkhaven
Darkhaven, home to Konrad von Sonnesheim, the Lord Marshal, and to Alexandre Dozsenc, the Blood Bishop, is cut off from the rest of the world.

It is the only place that survived a devastating plague that wiped out everyone beyond its borders.
Greenthistle Wood
According to the tale, two humble villages—Shady Hollow and Riverton—lie in Greenthistle Wood.

It is a place overrun and terrorized by two witches, a giant, and a host of vile, predatory fiends who have filled the wood with unspeakable cruelty and mayhem.
Greywake's Expedition
Greywake’s Hill was once a thriving and prosperous island, but something sinister has happened.

Follow the tale of the many who have fallen to Zzyg'th, the Hadal Tyrant, and to Chathoa, the Herald from Beyond.
 

Take Talebound Classes and Talents for a Spin

Across all classes, movement and defense are central, and each class can double jump, dodge, and guard, making positioning a key part of combat.
 

SLAYER

The Slayer's martial might and monster hunter knowledge give him the rare physical tools to combat the beasts of folklore. Wield a sword to cut down eldritch foes and a gun for when a blade doesn’t suffice
  • Slash : a sequence of three attacks that damage enemies directly in front of you, with higher damage and stun on the final blow. In Talebound, lesser enemies flinch when attacked, making for dynamic combat.
  • Explosive Shot : Fire your shotgun at enemies in front of you. Closer foes take damage from multiple shots. Empower this ability to deal greater damage.
  • Minefield : Allows you to leap backward and hurl an arc of mines in front of you. These mines inflict damage and slow your enemies.
  • Shrapnel Roun d: Fires multiple rounds at enemies, bouncing between foes and inflicting damage to each it hits.
  • Throwing Knives : Moves the player quickly and strikes nearby enemies. It can cancel other attacks for fast movement.
  • Silver Bolt : Leap into the air and drive a silver bolt into your foe, immediately inflicting damage to the enemy with the highest health in range.

     

INQUISITOR

The Inquisitor’s zeal lights every corner and burns the face of evil, no matter the illusions it uses to hide.
  • Purify : A sequence of three attacks that damage enemies in front of you, each strike more powerful than the last.
  • Condemn : Damages enemies in front of you, inflicting holy damage and reducing their movement speed. Crucially, it is castable while moving.
  • Denounce : An empowered ability that inflicts more damage the longer you stand and forces enemies to confess.
  • Light’s Wrath : Conjures a wrathful sun above an enemy, burning enemies nearby.
  • Rapture : Wreathes enemies in damaging flames for a short time. These flames detonate on your command.
  • Radiant Burst : Can be cast while moving to hurl fire at a nearby target that explodes on impact, burning all nearby enemies.

     

WITCH

The Witch uses lightning, poison, spiders, moonlight, thorns, and ravens to overwhelm enemies with a darker, spell-driven style.
  • Brewing Storm : A sequence of three attacks that inflict lightning damage, with the last strike dealing more serious damage.
  • Bubbling Cauldron : Summons a plague of frogs from your cauldron. Frogs leap to a random enemy and explode, inflicting poisonous damage in a small area.
  • Feline Communion : Transforms you into a cat for a short time. While in this form, a shower of stars inflicts damage to all nearby enemies, and you may cast Crooked Path to blink forward, escaping through moonlight.
  • Winter Spiders : Summons a swarm that skitters forward, including a brood mother that explodes, inflicting serious damage in a small area.
  • Moonlight Ravens : A channeled spell used while moving to summon a flock of ravens that each seek out nearby targets, inflicting damage to them.
  • Thorns : Launches thorns that erupt beneath the two nearest enemies.
As with all our PTR testing, things may change. Several Talebound talents are still in progress, and fine-tuning is ongoing.

Dive into the Talebound demo, try the available features, and share your thoughts.

contentHtml:
A new World of Warcraft: Forever short story called "Unbowed" focuses on the story of Cormack, a former Scarlet Crusader, as he struggles to accept his undead existence.

Blizzard
View Original
Cormack, a former Scarlet Crusader in life, now raised as Forsaken, struggles to accept his undead existence. After confronting both his past and the beliefs that defined him, he is left to ask himself: can a Forsaken still serve the Light?

Join Cormack for a special fireside telling of our newest short story, “Unbowed”.

Written By : Sean Copeland
Illustrated By : Surfside 3D
Narrated By : Jesse Burch as Cormack

title.en: Blizzard Hints The WoW: Forever Podcast Will Continue
title.es: Blizzard sugiere que The WoW: Forever Podcast continuará

summary.en: Blizzard Hints The WoW: Forever Podcast Will Continue...
summary.es: Blizzard sugiere que el podcast de WoW: Forever continuará...

contentHtml:
In Blizzard's latest episode of the WoW Forever Podcast, viewers noticed a not-so-subtle giveaway that the podcast likely plans to continue past WoW: Forever's launch!

In the background of each podcast episode, the sign in the back has changed - sometimes hinting at in-game coordinates, sneakily giving away a beta key, and more. Now, for the fifth of six officially planned podcast episodes, the sign has revealed the possibility that six isn't the final number.


The WoW: Forever Podcast has been massively popular within the community. Consistent communication has been something players have wanted for Classic World of Warcraft, and the WoW: Forever Podcast has felt like an answer to that request.

While we can't confirm the true extent of the sign's truthfulness - after all, it could just be referencing the final, sixth planned episode - the hope is that this type of communication continues. Blizzard has been incredibly responsive to player feedback throughout the beta, so if this podcast is something players are interested in going forward, they should continue to make that known!

summary.en: New Talebound Toy Allows Companion Pets to Fly on an Enchanted Book...
summary.es: El nuevo juguete Talebound permite a las mascotas acompañantes volar en un libro encantado...

contentHtml:
A new item datamined on the Patch 12.1.7 PTR allows battle pets to fly on an enchanted flying book!

Talebound Guide


In the recent Patch 12.1.7 PTR build, we've datamined the Hexed Tiny Tome toy. This is listed as dropping from Talebound, the new Roguelite game mode in Patch 12.1.7.



This toy seems very similar to the existing Magical Saucer, which allows your companion pet to follow you around on a disc. With this toy, your companion pet will likely follow you on a flying book, similar to the Shadowbound Storybook mount that is also obtained from the game mode.

 


When this toy releases in Patch 12.1.7, don't forget about the Narcissa's Mirror toy! This toy will allow you to change the model of your pet, so you can have a mini-me following you around on an enchanted flying book.
